summary: Iteration 43: frontend-only test of the POS floating cart, bottom payment sheet and QRIS confirmation redesign. The live DB has 0 riders and 0 stock, so the real POS was only checked in its guarded state (PIN gate, then the pick-rider hint, no floating cart or sheet). The full flow was tested by intercepting GET /api/users?role=rider, /api/pos/stock, /api/payment-accounts/public and /api/attendance in Playwright. POST /api/sales was also intercepted, so no persistent sale was created. DESKTOP (1920x1080) works end to end: the floating cart shows Rp 24.000, the sheet opens with a single cart-panel, and cash/split/dine-in validation is correct. QRIS checkout is disabled and labelled 'Konfirmasi QRIS' until pos-qris-confirm-button is clicked in the QR preview. Closing via the backdrop keeps the cart. Checkout closes the sheet, clears the cart, removes the floating button and shows the sale-receipt modal with QRIS Rp 24.000. After closing the receipt there is no leftover overlay and body pointer-events is auto. MOBILE (390x844) IS BROKEN: the fixed bottom-nav (z-50, y=780-844) covers both the floating cart button (bottom-5, z-40) and the bottom of the payment sheet. elementFromPoint at the checkout button centre returns bottomnav-more, and cart-clear is covered by bottomnav-inventory. Playwright click on checkout-button times out. So a cashier on a phone cannot open the sheet or complete a sale. There is no horizontal overflow on mobile (scrollWidth 390 = innerWidth).

ui_bugs.issue: The fixed bottom-nav (Layout, z-50, bottom-0, 64px) sits on top of pos-cart-floating-button (fixed bottom-5 left-4 z-40). Pointer events go to bottomnav-dashboard, so the button cannot be tapped on mobile.

The sheet panel is anchored at the viewport bottom (items-end), but the bottom-nav covers its last ~64px. cart-total, cart-clear and checkout-button are hidden and unclickable, so no sale can be completed on mobile.

qrisConfirmed is not reset when the cart changes. After confirming QRIS for Rp 24.000, clicking cart-plus raised the total to Rp 36.000 and checkout stayed enabled as confirmed. Cart-clear and adding products also leave it unchanged.
For a QRIS sale, cash_received is sent as the stale splitCash value (10000 seen in the POST body) because the code is cash_received = pay==='cash' ? cash : splitCashAmount. It should be 0 for qris.

issues: There is no explicit close button or handle, and Escape does not close the sheet. It can only be dismissed by tapping the backdrop.
cart-clear leaves an empty sheet open showing 'Rp 0' and a disabled 'Konfirmasi QRIS'. Consider closing the sheet when the cart becomes empty.
If the rider has no QRIS account, choosing QRIS shows nothing and checkout stays disabled with no explanation. Add an empty-state message.
The payment method (QRIS) stays selected for the next sale after checkout. Consider resetting it to cash.

action_items: Mobile: raise the payment sheet above the bottom nav (e.g. portal it to body with z-[60]), or add bottom padding of nav height plus safe-area-inset to the sheet panel so checkout-button and cart-total are visible.
Mobile: move pos-cart-floating-button above the bottom nav (e.g. bottom-24 lg:bottom-5, z-[55]).
Reset qrisConfirmed whenever the total or cart changes (useEffect on total/cart/bcart) and in cart-clear.
Send cash_received as 0 for pay==='qris'. Optionally reset splitCash when switching payment method.
Add a close button and Escape handling to the payment sheet; add an empty state when there are no QRIS accounts.
critical_code_review_comments: POS.jsx line 286/287: the z-40 floating button and the z-50 sheet are both rendered inside the page, and the Layout bottom-nav is also z-50, so it wins on mobile.
POS.jsx: qrisConfirmed is only reset on payment-method switch and after a successful sale, not on cart mutation.
POS.jsx line 195: cash_received leaks splitCashAmount into QRIS sales.
The split payment's QRIS portion has no QR show/confirm step, unlike pure QRIS. Confirm this is intended.

success_rate.frontend: Desktop 100% of requested flows; mobile 0% for checkout (blocked by bottom-nav overlap)

seed_data_creation: None. Riders, stock, QRIS accounts and the POST /sales response were all mocked with Playwright page.route, so no DB mutation and no test sale exist.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The live DB has 0 riders, so the real POS shows only pick-rider-hint. To test, log in (set localStorage si4am_legal_2026-06-01=accepted, fill login-identifier-input 'baa', click login-continue-button, fill pin-digit-0..5 with 130994), go to /pos, and press pin-key-N for 130994. Then mock /api/users?role=rider, /api/pos/stock, /api/payment-accounts/public, /api/attendance and POST /api/sales via page.route. Select the rider with absen-button, then pos-rider-select, then Escape. On mobile, run elementFromPoint on checkout-button and pos-cart-floating-button to verify the bottom-nav overlap fix.
